findings.statement: Complete observed square-free degree-3 expansion over the frozen ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE P/O coordinate eliminates every frozen degree-2 contradiction on 6x3-k3, 4x5-k4, and 6x3-k4.

Although the raw cubic catalogs contain tens to hundreds of thousands of triples, only 75, 371, and 16 additional matrix-rank directions beyond degree 2 are observed on the three hard repaired-coordinate carriers.

The scalar target remains two-dimensional while the structural polynomial realization requires degree 3 on the hard repaired-coordinate carriers; output dimension and interaction degree are distinct invariants.

nonclaims: Degree 3 is not proved universally sufficient.
The cubic pivot monomials are not invariant syndrome formulas.
No final coefficient gauge or closed-form decoder has been selected.
No Q-A/Q-F or standard-7x6 claim follows.
next_question: What is the outcome-independent cubic quotient basis modulo degree 2, and which two target directions inside its span carry the scalar output?
